content.user_title: Moderate Content with Azure AI Safety
content.value_statement: Unsafe text and images can create policy, trust, and compliance risks. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code concise TypeScript patterns for Azure AI Content Safety.
actual_capabilities: Shows package installation for the Azure AI Content Safety REST SDK and Azure identity libraries.
Demonstrates API key and DefaultAzureCredential client setup for TypeScript projects.
Provides examples for analyzing text and images with Azure harm categories.
Explains blocklist creation, item updates, listing, deletion, and analysis with blocklists.
Includes a moderation helper that returns allow status, flagged categories, maximum severity, and blocklist matches.
Summarizes harm categories, severity levels, output modes, API endpoints, and key SDK types.
limitations: Requires an Azure AI Content Safety resource and valid credentials.
Provides documentation examples, not a complete application or test suite.
Moderation thresholds must be validated against each product policy and user population.
Azure service limits, regional availability, and pricing are outside the skill content.

use_cases.title: Add Text Moderation
use_cases.description: Use TypeScript examples to analyze user messages for hate, sexual, violence, and self-harm categories.

use_cases.title: Review Image Uploads
use_cases.description: Prepare image moderation flows with local image content or blob URLs before publication.

use_cases.title: Manage Policy Blocklists
use_cases.description: Create and maintain custom blocklists for domain-specific terms that require review or blocking.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up the Client
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new TypeScript project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to set up Azure AI Content Safety in a TypeScript service using environment variables and the REST SDK.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze User Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Add a basic moderation check for text content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me write a TypeScript flow that sends user text to Azure AI Content Safety and explains each returned severity category.

prompt_templates.title: Moderate Uploaded Images
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan image safety checks for uploads or stored media.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a TypeScript image moderation workflow using Azure AI Content Safety with both local files and blob URLs.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Policy Helper
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced helper for product moderation rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a moderation helper design that combines severity thresholds, blocklist matches, audit logging, and clear allow or review decisions.

output_examples.input: Prompt: Explain how to analyze text with Azure AI Content Safety in TypeScript.
output_examples.output: The response outlines client setup, the text analysis request, category interpretation, severity thresholds, and error handling with the SDK type guard.

output_examples.input: Prompt: Help me add a custom blocklist for prohibited product terms.
output_examples.output: The response describes creating a blocklist, adding terms with descriptions, using the blocklist during text analysis, and checking matches.

output_examples.input: Prompt: Review my moderation policy for image uploads.
output_examples.output: The response maps policy needs to image analysis inputs, severity handling, review queues, and privacy-aware logging practices.

best_practices: Store Azure credentials in environment variables or managed identity, not in source files.
Tune severity thresholds by category and review results with product policy owners.
Log moderation decisions and reasons without storing unnecessary sensitive user content.
anti_patterns: Do not hard-code Azure API keys or endpoints in shared code.
Do not treat automated moderation results as the only authority for high-impact decisions.
Do not send private user content to a moderation service without required consent and retention controls.

faq.question: What Azure service does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Azure AI Content Safety through the TypeScript REST SDK.

faq.question: Can it analyze both text and images?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples include text analysis, local image content, and blob URL image analysis.

faq.question: Does it support custom blocklists?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents creating, updating, listing, deleting, and using text blocklists.

faq.question: Which authentication methods are shown?
faq.answer: It shows API key authentication and DefaultAzureCredential for Azure identity integration.

faq.question: Is this a complete moderation application?
faq.answer: No. It is a reference guide with examples that must be adapted and tested in your application.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
